summary: This note documents the SERVICES view in the information schema, which lists existing Snowpark Container Services services in a database. It gives a table of 17 columns with their data types and descriptions, covering ownership, compute pool, DNS name, instance limits, auto-resume, warehouse and timestamps. It also includes a sample SELECT query that filters services by name pattern.
one_line: Reference for the SERVICES information schema view listing Snowpark Container Services services, their columns, and an example query.
key_facts: The SERVICES view shows existing Snowpark Container Services services in the database.
SERVICE_CATALOG (TEXT) is the database that the service belongs to.
SERVICE_OWNER (TEXT) is the name of the role that owns the service, or the app instance name if the service is in an app.
COMPUTE_POOL_NAME (TEXT) is the compute pool where the job was executed.
DNS_NAME (TEXT) is the DNS name associated with the service.
MIN_INSTANCES and MAX_INSTANCES (INT) give the minimum and maximum instances for the service.
AUTO_RESUME (BOOLEAN) is a flag that determines if the service can be auto resumed.
QUERY_WAREHOUSE (TEXT) is the name of the default query warehouse of the service.
CREATED (TIMESTAMP_LTZ) is the creation time of the service.
LAST_ALTERED (TIMESTAMP_LTZ) is the last altered time of the service.
LAST_RESUMED (TIMESTAMP_LTZ) is the last resumed time of the service.
COMMENT (TEXT) is the comment for this service.
The example queries my_database.information_schema.services with WHERE service_name LIKE '%myservice_%'.
SERVICE_OWNER_ROLE_TYPE (TEXT) is the type of the owner role.
